From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Thompson <ben.thompson@fintegrate.com>, Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fintegrate steering committee - exec sponsor scheduling

Hi Ben / Aisha —

Great to meet you both earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed next step: we recommend a 60-minute steering committee with your exec sponsor (economic buyer), procurement/legal, and security to align on decision criteria and procurement timeline. That gives us a chance to surface any requirements (SOC2, data residency, audit logs) and walk through high-level pricing scenarios so Procurement has the info they need.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue, Mar 16 | 10:00–11:00
- Wed, Mar 17 | 13:00–14:00
- Thu, Mar 18 | 09:00–10:00

Attached: steering_committee_agenda.pdf and a short capability one-pager (redwood-capability-one-pager.pdf).

Key asks for the meeting:
- Confirm exec sponsor + attendees (procurement, legal, security)
- Share any procurement questionnaire in advance (we'll pull together answers and evidence)
- Confirm primary decision criteria (cost, latency, data controls, SLA)

If one of these slots works, we'll lock it and send an invite with a short 30–40 minute decision-focused section + 15–20 minute optional demo.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: steering_committee_agenda.pdf, redwood-capability-one-pager.pdf

From: Ben Thompson <ben.thompson@fintegrate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@fintegrate.com>, procurement@fintegrate.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fintegrate steering committee - exec sponsor scheduling

Marissa —

Thanks for the follow-up and the materials. Michael Levin (our CFO) will be the executive sponsor for this initiative. Procurement and legal should definitely be on the call — I copied procurement.

Of the proposed slots, Wed, Mar 17 at 1:00pm PT looks best for Michael. Can you hold that and send a calendar invite?

A few notes to help you prepare:
- Primary decision criteria for us right now: total cost of ownership (including reserved vs on-demand pricing), latency (we're targeting ~<200ms tail for our critical paths), and data controls / auditability (SOC2 + retention/audit logs).
- We'll also need a short procurement questionnaire answered beforehand (standard template).

If you can send a 4–6 slide summary that maps how Redwood meets those criteria and attach a completed procurement questionnaire, that'd be perfect.

Ben
Ben Thompson
VP Product Operations | Fintegrate
ben.thompson@fintegrate.com | +1 (212) 555-0422

Thanks Ben — Wed 3/17 @ 1:00pm PT is locked on our side. Calendar invite to follow.

Per your ask, attaching an updated agenda and a concise 4-slide summary mapping Redwood to the three decision criteria you listed. Dev (SE) and Lauren (Sales Manager) are on the thread and will join the meeting.

Quick rundown of what we'll cover in the deck/meeting:
- Cost: reserved vs burst pricing and example TCO for your expected volume
- Latency: runtime design and benchmarks; tail latency mitigation (batching, routing)
- Data controls: private deployment options, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logging cadence

We'll also return the filled procurement questionnaire by EOD tomorrow. If there are any additional questions Michael wants to surface in advance, please send them to me and we'll incorporate.

Onward —
Marissa

Internal prep notes (Marissa / Lauren) —

Thanks for the heads up on attendees. Draft prep items I'm putting together:

- Slides: 1) Exec summary / ask (Marissa) 2) Architecture + deployment modes (Dev) 3) Performance benchmarks & tail-latency mitigations (Dev) 4) Pricing & TCO scenarios (Lauren)
- Evidence to attach: SOC2 Type II summary, KMS/HSM integration whitepaper, sample audit log export (anonymized), data residency options doc
- Procurement questionnaire: I'll start filling in answers for security, deployment, and SSO/Kerberos sections — will flag questions for legal/pricing where needed

- Roles on the call: Marissa (lead / decision mapping), Dev (technical deep-dive + demo), Lauren (commercial & pricing)

I'll attach a first-draft prep_slides_v1.pdf to the invite and the questionnaire.
